commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Matthias Jollenbeck had an easy-decision to make.
90+5' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Daniel Batz, who smothers the ball.
90+2' Here's the change. Jae-Sung Lee leaves the pitch and Armindo Sieb (Mainz) comes on as a substitute.
90+2' Today's match ends for Paul Nebel who will be replaced by William Boving (Mainz).
90+2' Here is a change. Danny da Costa is going off and Urs Fischer gives the last tactical orders to Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz).
90+1' 2 - 2 Danny da Costa (Mainz) scores with a header from inside the box after a goalmouth scramble.

84' Sebastian Hoeness prepares a substitution. Maximilian Mittelstadt is replaced by Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart).

82' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.

82' Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Matthias Jollenbeck with no other option than to blow for a foul.
79' The attendance is 33305.

77' 1 - 2 GOAL! Superb work from Tiago Tomas, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart), who beats Daniel Batz with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 1:2.
76' 1 - 1 What a beauty from just outside the box! Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power inside the right post.
75' Chris Fuhrich goes off the pitch and Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart) comes on.
75' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to substitute Luca Jaquez and he is replaced by Finn Jeltsch (VfB Stuttgart).
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Silas (Mainz) comes onto the pitch so that Sheraldo Becker can be given a rest.
72' Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

69' Great ball in from Maximilian Mittelstadt. Nikolas Nartey (VfB Stuttgart) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
66' POST! Paul Nebel (Mainz) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the right post. What a strike that was!
65' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) smashes the ball from the edge of the box and misses well wide of the left post.
65' That will be all from Lorenz Assignon who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Nikolas Nartey (VfB Stuttgart).
61' Stuttgart have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
60' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Daniel Batz intercepts the ball.
59' A corner kick by Stuttgart is thwarted by the well prepared Daniel Batz (Mainz).
58' Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball goes out of play and Stuttgart will have a goal kick.
56' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
55' Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Alexander Nubel.
51' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.
50' Kaishu Sano (Mainz) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Alexander Nubel has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
47' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
46' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
46' Referee Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
43' Paul Nebel (Mainz) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
39' 1 - 0 Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) gets to the ball inside the six-yard box and easily scores with a header. He directed the ball into the top corner of the goal off the right post, making the score 1:0.
39' Paul Nebel (Mainz) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

38' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header just wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Stuttgart.
35' 32:68 – the latest ball possession ratio.
32' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
31' Mainz fail to score from a corner as Alexander Nubel (VfB Stuttgart) leaps to collect the ball.
30' Alexander Nubel pulls off a glorious save! Phillip Tietz (Mainz) attempts to head home after a precise lofted cross. However, his effort only finds its way into the goalkeeper gloves.
29' Goal, no wait, Mainz have a goal disallowed due to a foul.
28' The corner kick from Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
26' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety.
25' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) heads on.
24' A lofted pass into the box is met by Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart), who rifles a shot just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
20' Kaishu Sano (Mainz) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
20' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
19' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
18' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
15' The game is interrupted as Phillip Tietz (Mainz) is flagged offside.
11' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) trips an opposition player and Matthias Jollenbeck signals a foul.

10' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.
7' Daniel Batz comes off his line to intercept the corner from Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart).
6' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart).
5' Stuttgart earn a corner.
5' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) blows a big chance to score! He slammed the ball from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it went narrowly over the crossbar.
4' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) will take the corner.
